name: Ambxst Roadie
description: The crew that keeps the show running while the stage changes. Boot: the screen stays in the background colour until the shell is ready, then the wallpaper and frame come in and the shell locks (unless you logged in through a greeter or an external locker is up), the bar following after you unlock. Shell start and reload: the wallpaper fades in while the frame, bar, notch and dock slide into place and the windows make room on one staged timeline; a reload through `ambxst run reload` (or the optional `ambxst` wrapper in extras/) plays it in reverse before the restart, and a tiny detached helper covers a cold kill the same way. Monitors coming and going: hotplug without a shell reload (panels unregister by the screen name latched at creation, stale unregisters are ignored, the wallpaper-manager role passes to a surviving screen, ~15 screen.name bindings are null-guarded during teardown). Focus and fullscreen: a pinned bar can live on the focused screen only and slide across when focus moves (Dual Screen Single Bar, switchable), a bar, dock or frame that hides for a fullscreen window releases the space it held, fullscreen detection sees games on an open special workspace, and the notch and dock count that workspace's windows. On Hyprland the compositor's window animation is matched to each of these moves for its duration. Shutting down: Reboot and Power Off from the power menu swell the notch into the whole screen, a line from a film or show fades in (a goodbye for a shutdown, a back-in-a-second for a reboot), and the command runs once it has been up long enough to read; Escape backs out. Also: no AI sidebar sweep or corner flash at start, and no volume or brightness pop-ups on their own after a start. Mod updates: a Check for updates button in Settings > Mods, optional automatic checks, and an update that needs a newer Ambxst says so before anything is installed and is offered together with the Ambxst update, in the order that keeps the mods working. Idle dimming can be kept for laptops only or turned off, so desktop screens stay at the brightness you set. The Settings window opens as a centred floating window sized to its screen instead of a tile, with no window rule. Replaces Ambxst Clean Load, Multi-monitor fixes, Mod Updater and Settings Float (it is all four, and more); it cannot be enabled together with any of them.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Spawns a second, detached Quickshell process (the veil) that listens on a socket in XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and draws wallpaper and frame surfaces while the shell is down
Runs `ambxst reload` itself when asked to reload through `ambxst run reload` or the roadie IPC target
Reads Hyprland monitor state through Quickshell.Hyprland
On Hyprland, runs `hyprctl eval` to retune the windowsMove animation for the duration of a shell transition or a bar slide, then restores it; remembers the originals in ~/.local/state/ambxst/
Runs the power menu's own reboot / power off command itself, a few seconds after the click, and keeps a small state file of quotes already shown in ~/.local/state/ambxst/
At boot, reads the login session's PAM service name over `loginctl` and looks for a running external locker, to decide whether to lock; locks with the Ambxst lockscreen
Declares a fixed window size for the Settings window until the compositor has placed it

Contacts the source of each installed mod (local directory, git remote, or raw.githubusercontent.com) to read its current manifest, and raw.githubusercontent.com for Ambxst's current version, when you check for updates or have automatic checks on
Installs mod updates through the mod manager's own update path, which rebuilds the shell generation

When you ask it to update Ambxst together with the mods that need the new version: opens a terminal that disables those mods, fetches their new versions, runs Ambxst's own installer (the one `ambxst update` runs, which asks for your password), enables them again and restarts Ambxst; keeps a copy of the previous packages in ~/.cache/ambxst/ until that has succeeded
Sends notifications through Ambxst's notification service when automatic checks find updates
